title: Congress.gov Notifications Congress.gov Enhancements for November of 2026
summary: We are pleased to bring you the Congress.gov enhancements for November of 2026. Enhancement – Legislation – Search Results Use the Legislation Text search form to take advantage of advanced search operators, then use the Legislation View link to go to Legislation search form results. The Legislation View link, available for results lists of 500 or less, allows you to see the additional information provided in the Legislation search results without re-executing your search. Note that the total number of results may be slightly lower when you follow the link because Legislation Text results count text versions of a bill while Legislation results count bills. One bill result may include multiple text versions.
